units.text: Aspose.HTML FOSS for Python reads and writes HTML documents through a DOM API, parses HTML source text into a document tree, and supports CSS styling and computed style inspection. It provides URL parsing and manipulation, encoding detection, and JavaScript evaluation via an optional QuickJS bridge. The product exposes low-level parsing and tokenization tools alongside high-level document construction and serialization capabilities.
Parse HTML strings, bytes, fragments, and files into a DOM document with aspose_html.HTMLDocument.parse(), aspose_html.HTMLDocument.parse_fragment(), and aspose_html.HTMLDocument.load().

Build, inspect, and mutate DOM trees — create and update nodes programmatically with aspose_html.dom.Document.create_element() and append_child(); read and write element attributes, classes, datasets, inline styles, and text content; and query documents by ID, tag name, class name, and selector-oriented helpers such as get_element_by_id(), get_elements_by_tag_name(), aspose_html.dom.TreeWalker, aspose_html.dom.NodeList, and aspose_html.dom.Range.

Match CSS selectors and stylesheets against elements and resolve the cascade — specificity, inline-vs-author rules, !important, and inheritance — with Element.get_computed_style(); the CSSOM surface (aspose_html.cssom.CSSStyleSheet, aspose_html.cssom.CSSStyleRule, aspose_html.cssom.CSSMediaRule, and related rule types) models stylesheets structurally.

Validate and manipulate URLs with aspose_html.url.URL, read and edit query strings with aspose_html.url.URLSearchParams, and detect byte-stream character encodings (BOM and content sniffing) with aspose_html.encoding.detect_encoding().
Execute JavaScript against a parsed DOM through aspose_html.js.JSContext, an optional QuickJS-backed bridge exposing DOM APIs to script code; requires the js extra.

The lower-level aspose_html.tokenizer.Tokenizer and aspose_html.tree.TreeBuilder classes implement the WHATWG tokenization and tree-construction algorithms directly, for callers who need that level of control.

Work with a broad set of specialized HTML element classes — aspose_html.dom.HTMLFormElement, aspose_html.dom.HTMLInputElement, aspose_html.dom.HTMLTableElement, and dozens more — each exposing the element-specific properties defined by its HTML interface.
Serialize complete documents, fragments, and individual elements back to an HTML string with the aspose_html.serialise() function or aspose_html.XMLSerializer.

The first example parses an HTML string into a DOM, locates an element by its identifier, creates a new paragraph, sets its text content, appends it to the container, and serializes the updated subtree.
The second example constructs a DOM, adds a styled element, creates a CSS style sheet, attaches it to the document, and retrieves the computed style property value for the element.
The following examples demonstrate working with URLs, querying elements, detecting encoding, executing JavaScript, and tokenizing HTML.
Modify URL search parameters using set.
Query elements by tag name and read text content.
Detect character encoding from byte input.
Execute JavaScript against the DOM.
Tokenize HTML source and inspect tokens.

Aspose.HTML FOSS for Python provides the aspose_html.HTMLDocument class as the primary entry point for parsing and loading HTML content, offering parse, parse_fragment, and load methods. It also exposes lower-level DOM, CSSOM, encoding, URL, tokenizer, and serialization APIs for fine-grained control over HTML documents.
The aspose_html.HTMLDocument class provides parse, parse_fragment, and load methods to construct HTML documents from strings or files, forming the main interface for loading and parsing HTML content.

The aspose_html.dom.Document class serves as the root of a DOM tree and provides methods such as create_element, append_child, get_element_by_id, and get_elements_by_tag_name for building and querying the document structure.

The aspose_html.cssom.CSSStyleSheet class represents a CSS stylesheet and works with aspose_html.cssom.CSSStyleRule and aspose_html.dom.ComputedStyleDeclaration to manage styles and computed style information.
The aspose_html.url.URL class parses and represents URLs with properties such as href, protocol, host, and pathname, and includes aspose_html.url.URLSearchParams for handling query strings.

The aspose_html.encoding.detect_encoding function performs WHATWG-compliant encoding detection on byte sequences, returning an aspose_html.encoding.EncodingDetectionResult with the detected encoding and confidence.
The aspose_html.js.JSContext class provides a QuickJS-backed execution context pre-wired to a Document, supporting JavaScript evaluation and module registration via aspose_html.js.ModuleRegistry.

The aspose_html.tokenizer.Tokenizer class implements the HTML tokenization algorithm, producing aspose_html.tokenizer.StartTagToken and aspose_html.tokenizer.CharacterToken instances for low-level parsing.
The aspose_html.serialise function and aspose_html.serialiser.outer_html utility serialize DOM nodes to HTML strings, while aspose_html.XMLSerializer supports XML serialization.
It adds full CSS selector and pseudo-class coverage, constraint validation, image and PDF rendering, and unrestricted JavaScript execution.
DOMParser class parses markup strings into DOM documents, currently supporting only text/html parsing.
URL class represents a URL.
URLParseError is raised when a string cannot be parsed as a URL.
URLSearchParams holds ordered query-string pairs with duplicate-key support.
XMLSerializer serialises DOM nodes to strings.
CSSCounterStyleRule is a @counter-style rule holding the counter style name and its descriptor declarations.
CSSFontFaceRule is a @font-face rule holding font descriptor declarations.
CSSImportRule is an @import statement rule.
CSSKeyframeRule is a single keyframe descriptor within a @keyframes rule.
CSSKeyframesRule is a @keyframes rule containing animation keyframe descriptors.
CSSLayerBlockRule is a CSS @layer block rule assigning child rules to a named cascade layer.
CSSLayerStatementRule is a CSS @layer statement rule declaring cascade layer order.
CSSMediaRule is a media rule scaffold for nested style rules.
CSSNamespaceRule is a @namespace rule recording a namespace URI and optional prefix for use in namespace-qualified selectors.
CSSPageRule is a CSS @page rule representing a @page at-rule that specifies styles for printed pages.
CSSPropertyRule is a CSS @property rule stub representing a @property at-rule declaring a custom CSS property with a type syntax, inheritance behaviour, and initial value.
CSSRule is a base class for CSSOM rules; its css_text and type getters raise NotImplementedError.
CSSRuleList is an ordered, live CSS rule collection.
CSSStyleRule is a style rule (selector { declarations }).
CSSStyleSheet is a minimal CSSOM stylesheet object.
CSSSupportsRule is a @supports rule with a condition and nested style rules.
AbortController controls cancellation of operations via an AbortSignal.
AbortSignal represents the signal half of an AbortController pair.
AbstractRange is a read-only boundary-point contract shared by range-family APIs.
Attr is an attribute attached to an Element; its specified getter always returns True.
BarProp is a bar property.
BroadcastChannel is a broadcast channel.
CDATASection is a CDATA section node; its node_name getter always returns '#cdata-section'.
CSSStyleDeclaration is a live view of an element's inline style attribute.
CharacterData is an abstract base for Text, Comment, CDATASection, and ProcessingInstruction providing the data property and character-data manipulation methods.
Comment is an HTML comment node; its node_name getter always returns '#comment'.
ComputedStyleDeclaration is a read-only resolved style declarations for an element.
Console is a console.
Crypto is a crypto.
CustomElementRegistry is a custom element registry; its define method raises NotSupportedError or TypeError (conditionally).
CustomEvent is an Event carrying an arbitrary detail payload.
DOMConfiguration is a baseline DOMConfiguration compatibility surface; its get_parameter and set_parameter methods raise NotSupportedError (conditionally).
DOMException is a base for all DOM exceptions.

DOMImplementation is a legacy DOMImplementation compatibility surface providing deterministic, side-effect free feature-probe behavior; its create_document method raises WrongDocumentError (conditionally).
DOMParser parses markup strings into DOM documents, currently supporting only text/html parsing; its parse_from_string method raises NotSupportedError (conditionally).
DOMRect class represents an axis-aligned bounding rectangle with mutable attributes x, y, width, and height, and computed properties top, right, bottom, and left that handle negative dimensions.
DOMRectList class is an immutable sequence of DOMRect objects supporting iteration, index access, and item() returning None for out-of-range indices.
DOMStringMap class provides a live dict-like view of an element's data-* custom attributes, reading from and writing to the owning element's attribute map directly on every operation.

DOMTokenList class is a live, mutable set of space-separated tokens backed by an element attribute implementing the WHATWG DOMTokenList interface for the class attribute, and its supports method raises TypeError.
DataCloneError class represents an error for objects that cannot be cloned.

Document class is the root of a DOM tree, with Document() creating an empty, standards-mode document, and its adopt_node, adopted_style_sheets setter, close, cookie setter, create_attribute, and create_cdata_section methods raise NotSupportedError or TypeError or InvalidCharacterError conditionally.

DocumentFragment class is a lightweight container for a sub-tree whose children are transferred to a new parent when passed to append_child, and its node_name getter always returns '#document-fragment'.
DocumentType class represents a document type declaration node, and its name attribute holds the doctype name.

Element class represents an HTML or XML element node created via Document.create_element, and its attach_shadow, insert_adjacent_element, insert_adjacent_html, and insert_adjacent_text methods raise NotSupportedError, NoModificationAllowedError, or _SyntaxError conditionally.
ErrorEvent class represents a script error event with parameters type, bubbles, cancelable, message, filename, lineno, colno, and error.
Event class represents a DOM event object with parameters type, bubbles, and cancelable, and constants AT_TARGET, BUBBLING_PHASE, CAPTURING_PHASE, and NONE.
EventTarget class is the base class for objects that can receive DOM events, and its add_event_listener and dispatch_event methods raise TypeError or ValueError conditionally.
FocusEvent class represents a focus transition event with parameters type, bubbles, cancelable, and detail.
FormData class is a snapshot collection of form control name/value pairs.
HTMLAddressElement class represents an HTML address element.
HTMLAnchorElement class represents an HTML anchor element reflecting the href and target IDL attributes.
HTMLAreaElement class represents an HTML area element whose href resolves against document base URL.
HTMLArticleElement class represents an HTML article element.
HTMLAsideElement class represents an HTML aside element.
HTMLAudioElement class represents an HTML audio element.
HTMLBRElement class represents an HTML br element.
HTMLBaseElement class represents an HTML base element reflecting the href and target IDL attributes.
HTMLBodyElement class represents an HTML body element.
HTMLButtonElement class represents an HTML button element reflecting the type, value, and disabled IDL attributes, and its will_validate getter always returns False.
HTMLCanvasElement class represents an HTML canvas element, and its to_data_url method always returns 'data:,' and its transfer_control_to_offscreen method raises NotSupportedError conditionally.
HTMLCollection class is a live, ordered collection of Element-type children only, supporting iteration and integer index access.
HTMLDListElement class represents an HTML dl element.
HTMLDataElement class represents an HTML data element.
HTMLDataListElement class represents an HTML datalist element providing autocomplete suggestions and implementing the options IDL attribute returning a live collection of option child elements.
HTMLDetailsElement class represents an HTML details element reflecting the open IDL attribute.
HTMLDialogElement class represents an HTML dialog element reflecting the open IDL attribute.
HTMLDivElement class represents an HTML div element with no IDL-reflected attributes beyond those inherited from HTMLElement.

HTMLElement class is the base class for all HTML-namespace element types, and its content_editable setter raises _SyntaxError and its outer_text setter raises NoModificationAllowedError conditionally, while its access_key_label getter always returns '' and its toggle_popover method always returns False.
HTMLEmbedElement class represents an HTML embed element reflecting the src and type string properties and the width and height integer properties.
HTMLFieldSetElement class represents an HTML fieldset element for grouping form controls reflecting the name and disabled IDL attributes, and its type getter always returns 'fieldset'.
HTMLFigCaptionElement class represents an HTML figcaption element.
HTMLFigureElement class represents an HTML figure element.
HTMLFooterElement class represents an HTML footer element.

HTMLFormElement class represents an HTML form element reflecting the action, method, name, enctype, encoding, novalidate, target, and autocomplete IDL attributes, and its request_submit, reset, and submit methods raise NotSupportedError conditionally.
HTMLHRElement class represents the HTML thematic-break element.
HTMLHeadElement class represents the HTML head element.
HTMLHeaderElement class represents the HTML header element.
HTMLHeadingElement class represents HTML heading elements.
HTMLHtmlElement class represents the HTML document element.
HTMLIFrameElement class represents the HTML iframe element and reflects src, name, allow, sandbox, width, and height properties.

HTMLImageElement class represents the HTML image element and reflects src, alt, width, height, srcset, sizes, loading, decoding, and loading attributes; the decode method is not implemented, and complete, natural_height, natural_width, x, and y getters always return False, 0, 0, 0, and 0 respectively.

HTMLInputElement class represents the HTML input form control element and reflects type, value, name, checked, and disabled attributes; the set_range_text and show_picker methods raise NotSupportedError, the value_as_number setter raises InvalidStateError, and selection_direction, selection_end, and selection_start getters always return 'none', 0, and 0 respectively.
HTMLLIElement class represents the HTML list item element.
HTMLLabelElement class represents the HTML label element and reflects the for attribute.
HTMLLegendElement class represents the HTML legend element and reflects the form IDL attribute, which returns the owner form of the nearest ancestor fieldset, or None.
HTMLLinkElement class represents the HTML link element and reflects href, rel, and type attributes.
HTMLMainElement class represents the HTML main element.
HTMLMapElement class represents the HTML map element.
HTMLMarkElement class represents the HTML mark element.
HTMLMediaElement class is the base class for HTML media elements and reflects can_play_type, current_src, current_time, ended, network_state, and paused properties.
HTMLMenuElement class represents the HTML menu element.
HTMLMeterElement class represents the HTML meter element for displaying a scalar value in a range and reflects value, min, max, low, high, and optimum attributes.
HTMLNavElement class represents the HTML nav element.
HTMLNoScriptElement class represents the HTML noscript element.
HTMLOListElement class represents the HTML ordered list element.
HTMLObjectElement class represents the HTML object element and reflects data, type, name, width, height, and will_validate properties.
HTMLOptGroupElement class represents the HTML optgroup element for grouping options in a select list and reflects label and disabled attributes.
HTMLOptionsCollection class represents a live collection of option elements for a select element.
HTMLParagraphElement class represents the HTML paragraph element.
HTMLParamElement class represents the HTML param element.
HTMLPictureElement class represents the HTML picture element.
HTMLPreElement class represents the HTML preformatted text element.
HTMLProgressElement class represents the HTML progress element showing task completion and reflects value and max attributes.
HTMLQuoteElement class represents the HTML quote element.
HTMLRubyElement class represents the HTML ruby element.
HTMLScriptElement class represents the HTML script element and reflects src, type, async_, and defer attributes.
HTMLSectionElement class represents the HTML section element.
HTMLSelectElement class represents the HTML select element and reflects value, name, multiple, and disabled attributes; the add method raises HierarchyRequestError.
HTMLSmallElement class represents the HTML small element.
HTMLSourceElement class represents the HTML source element.
HTMLSpanElement class represents an HTML span inline container element with no IDL-reflected attributes beyond those inherited from HTMLElement.
HTMLStyleElement class represents an HTML style element and reflects the media and type IDL attributes.
HTMLSummaryElement class represents an HTML summary element, a disclosure summary for a details widget, with no IDL-reflected attributes beyond those inherited from HTMLElement.
HTMLTableCaptionElement class represents an HTML caption element.
HTMLTableCellElement class represents an HTML table cell element.
HTMLTableColElement class represents an HTML table column element.

HTMLTableElement class represents an HTML table element and provides live collection properties for navigating table structure; its delete_row and insert_row methods raise IndexSizeError when the index is out of range.
HTMLTableRowElement class represents an HTML table row element; its delete_cell and insert_cell methods raise IndexSizeError when the index is out of range.
HTMLTableSectionElement class represents an HTML table section element; its delete_row and insert_row methods raise IndexSizeError when the index is out of range.
HTMLTemplateElement class represents an HTML template element holding inert content, with its content property returning a DocumentFragment that holds the template's child nodes.

HTMLTextAreaElement class represents an HTML textarea multi-line text input element reflecting several IDL attributes, with its selection_direction, selection_end, and selection_start getters always returning 'none', 0, and 0 respectively, its type getter always returning 'textarea', and its set_range_text method raising NotSupportedError (conditionally).
HTMLTimeElement class represents an HTML time element and reflects the HTML datetime attribute.

HTMLTitleElement class represents an HTML title element whose text property reads and writes the element's first Text child node directly, and its text setter raises NotSupportedError (conditionally).
HTMLTrackElement class represents an HTML track element and its ready_state getter always returns 0.
HTMLUListElement class represents an HTML unordered list element.
HTMLUnknownElement class is an HTML unknown element interface (export-only, not registry-dispatched).

HTMLVideoElement class represents an HTML video element, with its video_height, video_width, webkit_decoded_frame_count, and webkit_dropped_frame_count getters always returning 0, and its request_picture_in_picture method raising NotSupportedError (conditionally).
HTMLWBRElement class represents an HTML wbr element.
HashChangeEvent class represents a same-document fragment navigation event.
HierarchyRequestError class is raised when the tree hierarchy is violated.
History class provides in-memory session history for a Window.
InUseAttributeError class is raised when an Attr is already in use by another element.
IndexSizeError class is raised when an index or size is out of range.
InputEvent class represents a text-input event.
IntersectionObserver class is provided for observing DOM intersections.
IntersectionObserverEntry class is provided for intersection observation notifications.
InvalidCharacterError class is raised when an invalid character is used.
InvalidStateError class is raised when an operation is performed in an invalid state.
KeyboardEvent class represents a keyboard event.
Location class provides the location of the current document.
MediaQueryList class provides a list of media queries.
MessageChannel class provides a channel for messaging between browsing contexts.
MessagePort class provides a port for messaging through a MessageChannel.
MouseEvent class represents a mouse or pointer event, with its offset_x, offset_y, page_x, and page_y getters always returning 0.
MutationObserver class observes DOM mutations on a target node; its observe method raises InvalidStateError (conditionally).
MutationRecord class represents one DOM mutation notification record.
NamedNodeMap class is an ordered map of Attr objects keyed by attribute name; its remove_named_item method raises NotFoundError (conditionally).
Navigator class provides information about the user agent.
NoModificationAllowedError class is raised when a node cannot be modified in its current context.
Node class is an abstract base class for all WHATWG DOM nodes; its insert_before, remove_child, and replace_child methods raise NotFoundError (conditionally).
NodeFilter class provides constants for TreeWalker and NodeIterator filtering, including bitmask constants for node type selection and filter return values.
NodeList class represents a live, ordered collection of Node objects, wrapping a reference to the underlying _children list of a node with immediate mutation visibility.
NotFoundError class is raised when a node is not found in the expected location, with code 8.
NotSupportedError class is raised when an operation is not supported, with code 9.
ParseError class records a parse error during tree construction, with code, line, column, and message attributes.
Performance class provides performance measurement capabilities.
PerformanceEntry class represents an individual performance entry.
PerformanceTiming class provides timing information for performance measurement.
PopStateEvent class represents a history traversal event carrying the active entry state, with type 'popstate' and state attributes.

Range class represents a contiguous portion of a document tree, defined by two boundary points, with compare_boundary_points, compare_point, is_point_in_range, select_node, and set_end_after members raising specific errors conditionally.
ResizeObserver class provides resize observation capabilities.
ResizeObserverEntry class represents a resize observer entry.
Screen class represents the screen object.
SecurityError class is raised when an operation is blocked for security reasons.

Selection class represents document-scoped selection with single-range semantics, with add_range, collapse, collapse_to_end, collapse_to_start, and get_range_at members raising specific errors conditionally.

StaticRange class represents an immutable boundary-point range initialized from an init object, with endpoints that do not auto-update on DOM mutations and cannot be changed after construction, and __init__ raising TypeError and WrongDocumentError conditionally.
Storage class provides storage capabilities.
StyleSheetList class represents a live ordered stylesheet collection.
SubtleCrypto class provides cryptographic capabilities.
Text class represents a text node, with node_name getter always returning '#text' and split_text raising IndexSizeError conditionally.
UIEvent class is the base class for user-interface events, with type, bubbles, and cancelable parameters.
VisualViewport class represents the visual viewport.

Window class represents the per-document window object with EventTarget behavior, with confirm always returning False, crossorigin_isolated getter always returning False, device_pixel_ratio getter always returning 1.0, find always returning False, atob raising InvalidCharacterError conditionally, and btoa raising InvalidCharacterError conditionally.

HTMLTableColElement class represents the HTML table column element.

HTMLTableElement class represents the HTML table element, provides live collection properties for navigating table structure, and its delete_row and insert_row methods raise IndexSizeError conditionally.
HTMLTableRowElement class represents the HTML table row element and its delete_cell and insert_cell methods raise IndexSizeError conditionally.
HTMLTableSectionElement class represents the HTML table section element and its delete_row and insert_row methods raise IndexSizeError conditionally.
HTMLTemplateElement class represents the HTML template element holding inert content and its content property returns the DocumentFragment that holds the template's child nodes.
HTMLTitleElement class represents the HTML title element, its text property reads and writes the element's first Text child node directly, and its text setter raises NotSupportedError conditionally.
HTMLTrackElement class represents the HTML track element and its ready_state getter always returns 0.
HTMLUListElement class represents the HTML unordered list element.
HTMLUnknownElement class represents the HTML unknown element interface and is export-only, not registry-dispatched.

HTMLVideoElement class represents the HTML video element, its video_height, video_width, webkit_decoded_frame_count, and webkit_dropped_frame_count getters always return 0, and its request_picture_in_picture method raises NotSupportedError conditionally.
HTMLWBRElement class represents the HTML wbr element.

JSContext class is a JavaScript execution context backed by QuickJS, pre-wired to a DOM, its evaluate and eval_module methods raise JSEvaluationError conditionally, and its import_stub method is not implemented and raises NotImplementedError.
JSEvaluationError class is raised when a JavaScript expression throws an exception and wraps JSException so that callers do not need to import quickjs to handle JS errors.
ModuleRegistry class maps module specifiers to ES module source strings and holds an explicit mapping from module specifier strings to their ES module source code.
BlockFragment class represents geometry fragment for a block-level box.
BoxNode class represents a single box-tree node produced by build_box_tree and carries the orthogonal display triple per CSS Display L3 section 2.
BoxRoot class represents the root wrapper returned by build_box_tree.

ComputedStyle class represents an immutable layout-facing snapshot of an element's resolved style and wraps the ComputedStyleDeclaration produced by the cascade engine plus the Document style epoch at which it was produced.
Display class holds the outer and inner display roles per CSS Display L3 §2.1, representing the outer display role as block, inline, or run-in and the inner formatt...
EdgeSizes class holds logical edge sizes in CSS px units.
FragmentRoot class serves as the root wrapper for block-layout fragment output.
InlineTextFragment class represents a positioned inline text fragment for a single shaped run.
LineFragment class represents a single inline formatting context line box.
PageFragment class represents a single paginated fragmentainer (page box) with ordered content.
PageMarginBoxes class serves as a placeholder page-margin-box container for later paint stages.
ShapedRun class holds shaped text-run payload with deterministic metrics.
CharacterToken class carries one or more Unicode characters, with the tokenizer buffering consecutive characters and emitting them as a single CharacterToken for efficiency.
CommentToken class represents a comment token with data holding the comment content excluding the delimiters, and line and column indicating the source position.
DoctypeToken class represents a DOCTYPE token emitted by the WHATWG tokeniser, with name, public_id, and system_id attributes.
EndTagToken class represents an end tag token with tag_name, line, and column attributes.
EofToken class represents an end-of-file token, always the last token in a stream, with line and column attributes indicating the EOF position.
StartTagToken class represents a start tag token with tag_name, self_closing, and attributes attributes.
Tokenizer class is the WHATWG HTML tokeniser that converts a Unicode string produced by encoding detection into a stream of typed tokens consumed by the tree constructor.
TokenizerState class lists all tokeniser states defined in WHATWG HTML Living Standard §13.2.5, with each value being the integer identifier used internally.
TreeBuilder class drives the WHATWG tree construction algorithm, consuming tokens from a Tokenizer and building a Document tree.
URL class represents a URL.
URLParseError class is raised when a string cannot be parsed as a URL.
URLSearchParams class holds ordered query-string pairs with duplicate-key support.
